open_points.subject: failed-run release and end-time spool cleanup
open_points.text: “a store call that fails changes no record (A18 rules 3-4) and the request is answered as an internal error by module:surface” contradicts “a removal that fails or is interrupted fails nothing” and step 4’s unqualified “capability:store.remove_run_spool removes the run's files”
open_points.question: What happens when remove_run_spool fails during release, cancellation, refusal, or successful completion: does the request succeed with cleanup deferred, or return internal_error and stop the kernel?
options: Keep the run transition successful and defer remaining cleanup to startup
Return internal_error and stop after preserving the already-written run transition
open_points.default_guess: Keep the run transition successful and defer remaining cleanup to startup.

open_points.subject: accepting a proposed binding
open_points.text: “a proposed one is read against the manifest again as before a send (A08 rule 6)” conflicts with “on the first failing check in A08 rule 5 order”
open_points.question: Does acceptance rerun every proposal check, including selected-instance and request-shape checks, or only the record checks performed before a send?
options: Rerun every A08 rule 5 proposal check
Run only A08 rule 6 send-time record checks
open_points.default_guess: Rerun every A08 rule 5 proposal check, as A08 rule 7 requires.

open_points.subject: startup installed-instance validation
open_points.text: “for one it also selects an instance for, a manifest record that cannot be read or fails a check of the record itself (A08 rule 5) stops the start naming it”
open_points.question: Which operation or capability entry is checked at startup, and in what order, when A08 rule 5 defines operation-specific checks but check_installed_instances is given only a service and selected instance?
options: Check only service-level structure and selected-instance headers needed for collision detection
Check every capability entry in a specified deterministic order
Check only operations referenced by stored bindings
open_points.default_guess: Check only service-level structure and the selected-instance header facts needed for the startup collision check.

open_points.subject: effect authority reported by run_effect_with_approval
open_points.text: “The effect sent once, on the exact request the owner was shown or under the owner's grant” omits the flow activation that steps 2–3 name as the authority for an ordinary draft-write send
open_points.question: May the outcome's EffectAttempt authority also be the run version's FlowActivation for draft-write sends?
options: Include FlowActivation as the third valid authority
Require an approval or grant for every reported effect
open_points.default_guess: Include FlowActivation for an ordinary draft-write send, with a fresh approval only after not_applied.
